fee_notes: Single-unit franchise fee is $35,000, paid in lump sum upon signing, non-refundable, and imposed uniformly. However, in 2025, initial franchise fees actually imposed ranged from $30,000 to $35,000. Additional fees paid to franchisor at signing include: Technology Configuration Fee ($7,500, reduced to $2,500 for additional units), Training Program fee ($7,500 for 2 trainees, $2,000 per additional trainee), Grand Opening Advertising Campaign ($0–$5,000), Delayed Opening Fee ($0–$5,000), On-Site Location Evaluation ($0–$1,000), and PayMore Kiosk ($7,500–$15,000). For Multi-Unit Operator Agreements (minimum 5 stores), a Development Fee applies: $105,000 for first 3 stores plus $17,500 per additional store (5–9 stores); $175,000 for first 5 stores plus $17,500 per additional store (10+ stores), with additional $17,500 per store due upon lease signing.
raw_excerpt:
Franchise Fee: You must pay us an initial franchise fee of $35,000 for the right to establish a single Store under a Franchise Agreement. You must pay the initial franchise fee in a lump sum when you sign the Franchise Agreement. The Initial Franchise Fee is imposed uniformly on all franchisees that purchase a Store franchise. This fee is non-refundable.

In 2025, the initial franchise fees that we imposed ranged between $30,000 to $35,000.
